label: Claim State
description: Lifecycle of a CASE_CLAIM. An active claim holds the case until its lease runs out unrenewed; a parked claim holds it with no lease (work waiting on a decision); a released claim holds nothing and stays as the record that someone worked on the case.

terms.label: Active
terms.description: Held, and counts until lease_until passes unrenewed.

terms.label: Parked
terms.description: Held with no lease: the holder saved its state and is waiting for a decision.

terms.label: Released
terms.description: No longer held: done, failed, abandoned, or lost a simultaneous acquire.
